title: Privacy-Preserving Maximum Matching on General Graphs and its Application to Enable Privacy-Preserving Kidney Exchange (Extended Version)
reasoning: The paper deals with ethical concerns by addressing 'legal obstacles' and 'fear of manipulation, corruption, and coercion' in kidney exchange, aiming to enable the practice in countries where it is currently restricted due to these moral and ethical issues. The proposed privacy-preserving protocol seeks to ensure 'correct and fair computation' and protect sensitive medical data, directly tackling ethical shortcomings of existing centralized platforms.
